content: {"argument": "The witness test expects stripping 'www.' from hostnames with 2-character TLDs like '.co', but the changed regex now requires a minimum of 3 characters for the TLD portion ([a-z.\\-\\d]{3,63}), which excludes valid 2-character TLDs. This change was made without updating the associated comment that still claims TLDs must be at least 2 characters long, creating an inconsistency. Since the PR title indicates a refactor of URL normalization edge handling, and this change alters behavior for legitimate inputs, it constitutes an unintended regression unless the new restriction was explicitly intended and documented.", "concedes": true}
